blind.description: A medieval heraldic display composed of a round wooden backing board with riveted metal trim, two crossed arming swords with gold pommels and crossguards behind it, and a smaller green heater-style shield mounted on the front featuring a gold border and a weathered white chevron. The back shows banded wooden planks with leather handle straps. All surfaces are solid, stylized, and intact without floating or melted elements.
blind.from_above: A thin horizontal bar representing the shield's top edge, flanked by two rounded gold sword pommels, with the outward curved face of the central shield protruding slightly forward.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.5 to 3 feet tall and wide)

notes: footprint proportion 1.48x off the catalog (2.6 x 0.6 ft)
